source: author decision, in the lead's chat, 2026-10-28: the acceptance criterion is whether the final model can hold a normal conversation and show normal intelligence; a registered chat-quality check fixed before the run
procedure: Greedy generation, at most new_tokens tokens or EOS. The CPU W8A8 reference model (tools/models/fp8_blockwise_ref.py, exact dot, IEEE scale division) answers first; its answers are archived before any device run and are the expected answers. A device answer passes a turn when (1) it contains every keyword the CPU answer contains, case-insensitively, and (2) it contains the CPU answer's normalized text or the CPU answer contains the device answer's normalized text (containment either way). Token-by-token agreement with the CPU answer (length of the common prefix and exact equality) is reported for every turn. Keywords apply to the last turn of a prompt. A prompt passes when all its turns pass; the check passes when every prompt passes. The keywords are a-priori expectations of normal intelligence; a keyword the CPU answer itself lacks is reported and not required of the device.

turns: What is the capital of France? Answer with one word.
What is 17 + 25? Answer with the number only.
Tom is taller than Ann. Ann is taller than Bob. Who is the shortest? Answer with one name.
Reply with exactly the word OK in capital letters and nothing else.
My name is Alice. Please remember it and reply with one short sentence.
What is my name? Answer with one word.
Which shapes are in this image? Answer with a short list.
